title: Strategy
paragraphs: When I teleported to Melromarc Castle via the portal...
"Gueeeeeeeeeeeeeeeah!"

A Filolial-sama, identical to the one I saw in Siltvelt, was currently rampaging through Melromarc Castle and the castle town. Smoke is rising not only from the castle but also from the town below. Of course, the Filolial-sama we raised—who were dispatched to the Melromarc area—are working alongside the soldiers to quell the chaos, but it seems they’re struggling due to a lack of manpower.
“Gua-gua-guaa!”
It seems that Filolial-sama—subordinates of the giant Filolial—are gathering and surging toward the town below the castle, and a fierce battle is currently raging!
“Ugh… so the Filolial-sama are running amok over here too!”
“This is pretty serious. What should we do?”

“Kou, Elmelo, Yuki, and everyone from Siltvelt—please handle the suppression in the town below the castle! Sakura, Motoyasu, and I are heading toward the castle! Lars-chan and Eclair, come with us too.”
“Understood! Kou! I’ll take Lord Elmelo and head out to help with the suppression!”
“Got it! Elmelo! Let’s do this!”
“Yes!”
Kou slipped under the elephant’s legs, transformed into his Filolial form, and, together with Yuki-chan, led the people of Siltvelt as they dashed toward the town below the castle.
“Your Majesty!”
As for us, Éclair took the lead and we ran toward Melromarc Castle.
“Let’s go!”
Soldiers lay sprawled on the ground inside the castle—perhaps because Filolial-sama had forced her way in.
“Wow, they’re really wreaking some serious havoc here…”
“But this situation is a little strange.”
Rival furrows his brow as he looks at the soldiers.
“Gaelion, is something wrong?”
“According to Gaelion’s analysis, I thought that Trash… the Wise King of Wisdom was in command of this operation.”
“Yeah.”
“Would that Wise King of Wisdom really send Filolial and his lot all the way to the castle where his own precious family lives?”
“…Now that you mention it, that’s true… but doesn’t he consider his wife and daughter—who betrayed him—to be family?”

“No… From what Gaelion knows from speaking with the Wise King of the First World, he’s the kind of person who would never allow harm to come to his family, no matter what. That’s true even if he were face-to-face with a queen trying to curry favor with Naofumi.”
“Well… that might be true in that world, but in this one, Motoyasu killed that princess right in front of him…”
Rival looks like he’s having a hard time accepting that.

“Gaelion only heard this secondhand, but the story goes that when the queen was killed by Takt and the princess, he did impose a punishment—but he judged that it had crossed a line he couldn’t condone, so he brought them to justice… He’s not the type to actively put anyone in danger.”
“So, does that mean this operation is being carried out without the Wise King’s knowledge?”
“I don’t know about that. Either way, our priority is to subdue the Filolial-samas rampaging inside the castle.”
We hurried to the throne room. There, we found the room bearing the scars of a fierce battle. The Filolial-samas who had been serving as guards for Melromarc lay fallen on the floor.
“Ah… aaah… Filolial-sama…”
I rushed over to the fallen Filolial-sama to check his condition, but… he was already dead…
“Aaaahhhhhhh…!”
“This is… terrible…”
“Your Majesty! Where are you? Your Majestyyyyyy!”

Éclair calls out to the Queen in the throne room, which is now completely deserted. But there is no answer. I’m concerned about the safety of the Queen and her Finacée, but more than that, it’s Filolial-sama.

Ah… this child is Knight-kun. He was named “Knight”—a combination of “night” and “knight”—because his hair was a deep indigo blue, like the Darkness of the night, just like Luna-chan’s. To think that child… would end up in such a pitiful state…
“Is there no one here!?”
“Ugh…”
Just then, a soldier—protected by the battered Filolial-sama—collapsed from the shadows by the door.
“You there! Are you okay!?”
“Are you okay!?”
Father and Éclair rushed over and cast healing Magic on Filolial-sama and the soldier.
“Haa… haa… Thank you, Heroes. This child protected me, and I barely…”
“Ugh… It hurt so much… I couldn’t move, so I could only protect this person…”
“Just being able to protect him is enough!”
Oh… If even just one person was saved, that’s enough.
“What about Her Majesty the Queen!?”

“Well… A mysterious army, accompanied by that strange Filolial, stormed the castle, broke through the defenses with overwhelming force… Just when I thought they’d reached the throne room, they swept aside the guards and forcibly carried off Her Majesty the Queen, Lady Melty, and the guests entrusted to the Heroes…”
“So they got the jump on us… I see. The Wise King realized the Queen was a weakness, so he took her first.”
“Meticulous to the very end… Is this the Wise King’s scheme…?”

A dark, seething emotion is welling up from the depths of my heart! That Trash! Not content with just continuing to torment Father, has he gone so far as to inflict such cruel treatment on Filolial-sama and the others?! I’d been cutting him some slack because he reformed in the first world, but I won’t show him any mercy now!
“Mel-chan!”
Sakura-chan is tracking the scent to find her Finacée!
“We’re constantly playing catch-up… Does this mean Motoyasu-kun and Gaelion-chan’s secret plan won’t work on Aultcray consumed by a thirst for revenge? Aultcray came, didn’t he?”

“No… the king wasn’t there. I could tell a suspicious figure in a robe was in command… but the women who seemed to be under his command were terrifyingly strong… and among them, in particular… I believe that one was a woman of the Aotatsu race. That one… possessed monstrously formidable strength and fought against the Hakuko people brought by the Heroes… and in the midst of that, the princess and the guests were taken hostage… so the Queen and the Hakuko people had no choice but to…”
“To defeat the Filolials… no, wait, since there were so many of them, they hadn’t been able to enhance themselves as much as Sakura-chan and her group… If you’re outnumbered…”

It’s true that the Filolial-sama I raised possess ample strength. I did raise them properly, but pushing their potential to the limit takes an absurd amount of time… so I can’t deny that their training was insufficient. However, I’m certain I made them strong enough to handle the remnants of the Takt faction without any trouble!
“The Aotatsu species… it must be Nelshen. He’s the leader of the Takt remnants.”

“I suppose so. According to Motoyasu-kun and Gaelion-chan, he can go beyond Beastman transformation and become an Aotatsu, so it wouldn’t be surprising if he’s been sharpening his fangs and building his strength for revenge.”
“That pigggggggggg! I’ll never forgive him!”

Just how much longer will that representative pig of Shieldfreeden drag us down in this world?! I absolutely will not forgive him anymore! I’ll capture him alive, peel off his scales one by one, and make him taste the hell of this world! The crime of killing Filolial-sama deserves a thousand deaths!
“Either way, we have to go after them… Sakura-chan, can you pick up the scent of Melty-chan? And Lars-chan, too?”
Technically, Tiger Guy is registered as a slave under the Panda’s command. So the Panda checks the slave registry.
“…No luck. Maybe someone’s jamming the signal—I can’t pinpoint their location.”
“Mel-chan…”
Sakura-chan follows the scent out of the hallway and heads toward the terrace. But just as she reaches the terrace, she turns around and shakes her head.
“The scent disappears right here…”
“Does that mean she was whisked away…?”
“If that were the case, the scent should be wafting into the sky.”
Rival sniffs the air but tilts her head in confusion.
“It feels like she vanished all of a sudden… We might be better off assuming she was taken away by the Hero’s teleportation.”
“An unusable staff from Aultcray showed up… and they took her away via teleportation? No, did they bring the missing holder of the Seven Holy Weapons from somewhere else?”
“It’s possible… Reincarnated individuals are womanizers. There’s definitely a chance they’re cooperating after being sweet-talked by a woman from the Takt remnants.”
“Guh… They’re a pain in the neck no matter what…”
If the Takt remnants have secretly made contact with the reincarnated ones who were secretly hiding the Seven Holy Weapons, then this is an extremely troublesome situation indeed!
“…I see. Now I understand why even the toughest warriors of Siltvelt are having a hard time against those strange Filolials.”

Father nodded as if he were fully convinced. It means they’ve undergone Limit Breaks and raised their levels sufficiently. Even if their enhancements were incomplete, it’s understandable that they’d still pose a threat to ordinary soldiers and knights. That’s just how immense the power hidden within Filolial-sama is.

“For now, let’s get the people of Siltvelt to help us deal with the commotion in Melromarc, and head to Shieldfreeden as soon as possible. Since they’ve already neutralized our trump card, we can’t act recklessly, but we can’t afford to suffer any further losses either.”
“Understood.”
“They really are a bunch that causes nothing but trouble, aren’t they…? Looks like we’ll have to stay on our toes. Let’s make sure we’re fully prepared for whatever might happen.”
“Yeah!”
And so, after regrouping, we teleported to Shieldfreeden.
The portal dropped us right into the courtyard of the building where Shieldfreeden’s leadership was located.
“Buzz-buzz-buzz!”
The moment we materialized, a barrage of gunfire and Magic attacks came flying at us.
“Shooting Star Shield!”

Father used the Shooting Star Shield—a technique he’d copied and mastered in Zeltoble—to create a barrier that absorbed all the incoming bullets and Magic. We’ll strike back immediately! For the sake of Filolial-sama and the others!
“Bryu—”
Just as I was about to unleash a Brionac, I heard a voice.
“H-Heroes! And Divine Dragon! Please wait! A reckless counterattack is dangerous!”
It seems that Shieldfreeden soldiers are stationed along the outer wall of the building, forming a formation to surround it. The soldiers, having spotted us, are saluting.
“Motoyasu, everyone! Let’s go!”
We hurry to escape beyond the building’s grounds, to a spot we believe is out of their range. Even so, bullets are still flying our way.
“What’s the situation?”

“Currently, within the castle of our nation, Shieldfreeden, former Representative Nelshen is barricaded inside with terrorists posing as the Wise King, using hostages as human shields. Dragons and griffins have gathered around the building, and we can’t even get inside…”
“We’ve confirmed they’re installing mysterious equipment on the castle roof… but this is beyond our control.”
Hostages again! These guys are truly despicable to the core!
“What’s the damage like?”
“The terrorist posing as the Wise King of Wisdom and Nelshen… the remnants of the Takt faction are firing what they call ‘warning shots’—but it’s actually large-scale Ceremonial Magic…”
As the soldier speaks, the soldiers point toward the area surrounding the castle. A mountain of rubble has formed there.
“This is terrible… If we’re not careful, this place could be dangerous too.”
Father is beating around the bush, but from my perspective, it’s not that much.
“If any Ceremonial Magic comes our way, I’ll neutralize it.”
“Yeah. Motoyasu, please be as careful as possible… So, what about the Filolials being reported in various countries?”

“We’ve received reports that they’re rampaging throughout various parts of Shieldfreeden. The Nelshen faction continues to broadcast that the only way to deal with them is to defeat the Shield Hero and Spear Hero.”
“I suppose so… They can’t very well admit they raised and released them themselves. So, what’s their objective?”

“For some time now, they’ve been broadcasting—almost like a speech—that the Heroes are the Demon King, the very ones leading the world into chaos, and that we are the messengers of justice. They claim we’re in the midst of an operation to lure out the Demon King with the cooperation of the Wise King. They’ve been going on and on about the background…”
Just as the soldier said, the sound is coming from speakers that appear to be part of the city’s communication infrastructure.
“Bububu! Bubububu! Bububu! Bubububububuhibuhibuhihihi!”

“The world is facing a crisis so grave that even the Wise King—who despises Demi-Humans—is cooperating with us. Now is not the time for conflict within the world… The Demon King, who makes no distinction between Demi-Humans, Beastmen, and humans, curtsies to those in power to seize the world for himself. Those who pose as the Shield Hero and Spear Hero must be eradicated from this world… right? “You sure do have a way with words.”

Father glares toward the castle with a sharp look in his eyes, as if a switch had been flipped. That expression bears a striking resemblance to Father who once protected Sakura-chan from Takt’s dragon in another world.
“And as for that ‘Wise King of Wisdom’… he’s even going so far as to deliver a speech via a video crystal. It’s practically a public relations battle at this point.”
That Trash—I have no idea where he came from—is sitting there with a stern expression, alongside a pig, in the castle’s conference hall. He seems to be treating this as proof.
